violations.text: An allergen statement is lacking on menus and/or point of order. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Eggs are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Cases of bottled water and shelf-stable milk were observed stored on the floor in the storage closet and kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
Cases of single service containers (cups) were observed stored on the floor in the kitchen and storage areas. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
The low boy in the service area was observed in poor repair, not maintaining ambient temperature of 41 degrees F or colder. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2026
An allergen statement was lacking on menus and/or point of order. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Staff on-site had food handler certification. List of consultants and classes provided. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.PIC provided soap during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

A spray hose observed hanging in the service area hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

Various purees and mixes were observed held at 44-46 degrees Fahrenheit in the service area low-boy. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All items requiring refrigeration were relocated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

Eggs are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Bottled water, shelf-stable milks, and cans of condensed milk were observed stored on the floor in the storage closet and kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
Ice scoop was observed stored with handle in direct contact with ice. Ice scoop was removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026
The low boy located in the service area was in poor repair, not maintaining an ambient temperature of 41 degrees or colder. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2026

The chlorine concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). The concentration of chlorine in the sanitizing solution must be between 50-100 ppm. PIC diluted to proper concentration during inspeciton. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/30/2026
The low boy was observed with an ambient temperature of 54 degrees. Per PIC, this unit will only be used for bottled water. New Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2026
